answer: Require each agent to post a bonded stake on the onyx ledger — a slashable deposit — before joining a shared task pool. Every newcomer enters a shallow lagoon: a low-trust sandbox where its work is double-checked by randomly assigned reviewers, and only successful jobs move it to deeper pools with larger rewards. Fabricating a thousand identities costs a thousand stakes plus reviewer fees, and any colluding review group caught by spot audits forfeits its own bonds. Cheap clones spread like yarrow roots, but each must pay full price to take hold.
